id: title:Gilbert09:show queryable table name on the sync complete step

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse-specific query naming conventions, distinguishing queryable table names from user-facing labels, and displays these names with tooltips in the warehouse connection UI.
review.reason: Adds a helper function and its tests to distinguish warehouse-specific queryable table names from friendly labels, and updates the warehouse connection UI to use this name with a tooltip. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and usability improvement for warehouse ingestion and query execution.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and tests, but the actual benefit depends on warehouse compatibility and user behavior, which are not independently verified.
